$comment: Indexes in Policy's named Firestore database `policy` (B5, docs/b5-commands-plan.md §7). Releases don't deploy indexes: create them by hand before the api that sweeps commands is released, then check them with `gcloud firestore indexes composite list --database=policy --project=graffiticode`. Composite: `gcloud firestore indexes composite create --database=policy --project=graffiticode --collection-group=commands --query-scope=COLLECTION --field-config=field-path=status,order=ascending --field-config=field-path=owner.leaseExpiresAt,order=ascending` (and the same with publication.state). Exemptions: `gcloud firestore indexes fields update text --database=policy --project=graffiticode --collection-group=<group> --disable-indexes` for each payload field below.
